en: Lady Alice!!
Good morning, Mikhail.  What brings you here so bright and early?
W-we've got a problem!  It's the professor; it's Nabokov!
Oh, what has Father done this time?
He's been spirited away by monsters.
Wait, what?!
Excuse me, I'm coming in.
Miss, I brought the items you requested.
Thank you, Lucille.  And with that, I should be all set to go.
Let me do one last check to be sure I'm ready.
Let's see...  Food, water, lantern, matches...
Heheh, Miss, why not quit now while you're ahead?
Huh, what?  You're saying there's no point in double-checking my provisions?  It wouldn't do to forget anything important.
Nah, that's not it.
What, then, are you trying to say?
It's already too late for the professor.
Oh geez, talk about blunt!  You didn't have to say that.

Think about it.  What do monsters usually do to someone they take?  I can't fathom that he'd still be unharmed.  The professor's probably being greedily devoured right about now, with the monsters leaving nary a trace of him for you to find.
Cut it out; don't say such things!  Father is surely still alive!
If you ran off to rescue a dead person and then met that same fate yourself, it would be pretty idiotic, no?
Out! Get out of here now, Lucille!
Yeah, yeah, I hear you.  Very well, mademoiselle.
Father and daughter, just a pair of roadkills for the vultures.  Ah, I do so hope such a terrrrrrible thing doesn't happen.
huhuhu, huhuhuhu, kekekekeke.
What the hell!  Stupid Lucille, you're such an inconsiderate jerk!
Well, setting her aside for now, I better hurry back down to the basement.
You might not think it, but Mikhail sure can be scary when he gets upset!
Urrrr.
Ah, you're back with us.
Mikhail?  Huh?  Wait, why am I in my room?
Ah, do you not remember what happened?  How you blacked out all of a sudden?
Now that you mention it, that does sound familiar.
Goodness.
Well, you ought to allow yourself to rest here for a time I think.
Nah, I'm all good now.
Whatever are you saying!  You've only just now awoken!
But, I really am fine.  Look at this.  See how energetic I am?
Please desist, Lady Alice!
Your body is in precarious condition right now!
But, Father needs....
I understand how you feel, but I implore you to give yourself more rest.
You're being such a worrywart, Mikhail.  I truly do feel right as rain.
There, you see?
P-please stop that!  Do you have a death wish?!
Eh?!
You were finally able to sustain life through the harvesting of outside energy!  Those magic dresses you've been using are bound to that selfsame life force.  If you carelessly overuse them then...!

note: gasp; guide 1389 'Haa, haa.. (breathing heavily)' does not match

en: Tell me, what did you mean by all that?
Sorry, I got carried away.  Please forget I said anything.
Mikhail!!
(He said I live by absorbing energy from outside?
My magic dresses are linked to my life force?
Absurd nonsense!
He makes it sound as if I'm just like a genomroid!)
N-no way?!
Milady? What happened?
You've got to be kidding me!  That can't be right!!
W-where might you be going?
I'm going to make certain!  About everything!
Lady Alice.
Milady.
Cut that out!  You probably knew too, didn't you?  That I'm not a human.
Yes, given that I served as the professor's research assistant.
Well then, don't bother being so kind to a nobody, to a fashion doll like me!
I won't hear of such things.  As far as I'm concerned, to me you are none other than Lady Alice!  I do not think of you as a doll.
And I'm quite certain the professor feels the same.
Lay off the consoling.  It doesn't much matter what happens to me anymore.
Whatever are you talking about!  What do expect to accomplish with an attitude like that!  Just who was it that said they'd rescue the professor!?
The professor must be down there waiting.  Waiting for milady to come and help break him out!  Do you intend to leave him be?!
The professor treasured you as a daughter.
Will you forsake him in return, milady?!
You're right.  I'm the only one who can break Father out, huh?
All right, Mikhail.  I'm going back down!
I'll let myself feel depressed, but only after I bring Father back!
Agreed, milady!  See you soon!
Milady, please take care out there.
Uggh....
Huh?!  I'm in my own room?
Why?  What happened?
Oh, so you're finally awake.
Lucille?!
You gave me quite the shock, suddenly collapsing like that.
Eh, I did?
It's true that while I was eating I did feel sick all of a sudden.
Lucille?
The truth is that, mistaking it for seasonings, cockroach bait went into the food...
Whaaaaaat?
Huhuhu.  Anyone at all could have made that mistake.
I don't want to suffer through that on account of an error!
Huhu.  Well pardon me, madame.
Hey!  Trying to dodge responsibility?!
Huhu.  Huhuhuhuhu.
Oh, Lucille.  Surely that couldn't have been on purpose, right?
Milady.  Good morning.
Oh, 'morning.  Nice day, isn't it.
I have finished preparing breakfast, so if you would please make your way to the dining room.
Okay, I will.  What about Father?
He is still asleep.
That figures.  Sheesh.
He's turned into such a lazy bum since he got back.
That's certainly an exaggeration.
It must be his research work that exhausts him so.
Well, either way.  All righty, I'll go wake him up myself.
Gently, please, if you would.
Huhu, I know.
